deviations.description: Temp-sync restoration mistake caught and corrected within this phase
deviations.reason: An intermediate .claude/ restoration step used `git show HEAD:<path>` after this task's own phases 1-6 had already been committed, so HEAD no longer pointed at the pre-task state -- this would have hand-deployed this task's own edits into .claude/, violating source-store-deploy-boundary.md. Caught before any gate ran against the mistaken state; all 8 files were re-restored from the pre-task commit (ed7d50e05, the session's starting HEAD) and verified byte-identical to it via diff before check-extension-docs.sh was re-run.
deviations.annotation: *(self-correction, not a plan deviation requiring a checklist annotation -- recorded in Phase 7's own task list note)*
